name: track irregularity sets
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于表征不同几何状态的一组轨道不平顺样本。

complete_examples.text: The purpose of this paper is to develop a probabilistic model to select representative and realistic track irregularity sets from numerous data with higher efficiency and accuracy.

In this paper, a track irregularity probabilistic model (TIPM) is proposed to select representative and realistic track irregularity sets with significantly higher efficiency, which lays the foundation for stochastic and probabilistic analysis of vehicle/track systems.
